Questions

Will it save battery?

On AMOLED and OLED screens black pixels use very little power, so true black wallpapers can help a little. On LCD screens, wallpaper choice does not change battery use.

Do I need root?

No. It works on stock Android.

Which phones?

Any Android phone. Best on AMOLED and OLED screens such as Samsung Galaxy, Redmi, POCO, Xiaomi, Realme, OnePlus, Vivo, OPPO, Nothing and Pixel.

Is it free?

Browsing, searching, saving favorites and setting wallpapers work without Pro. BackdropX Pro is an optional subscription or one-time purchase, with prices shown in the app in your local currency.
